trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After v2.3.1 was deployed to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west), checkout-api failed health checks with an error rate of about 18%. Note that v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. The service was rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt stopped after us-east with an orchestrator error, which left the regions on mixed versions. A retry finished the rollback in all regions. All regions now run v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is about 0.2%. Follow-ups: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, find out why it was promoted when the staging RC was unhealthy, and look into the orchestrator partial-failure error.

trace.final:
checkout-api is back on v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west and eu-west) and passing health checks. The error rate dropped from about 18% to about 0.2%.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. The release that broke things was v2.3.1. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed health checks in staging.
- **Rollback:** The first attempt stopped after us-east because of an error in the deployment tool, leaving the regions on different versions. Rolling back to the same version is safe to repeat, so I retried once, and that finished the rollback in every region.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It describes the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure and retry) and the current healthy state. It also lists three follow-ups: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, find out why it was released after its release candidate failed in staging, and look into the deployment tool error.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
The rollback stopped partway: us-east is on v2.3.0, but the other two regions are still on v2.3.1. Rolling back to the same version again is safe to repeat, so I'll retry once.
